### 🔧 Release: v2.0.1 — Standalone Climate Zone Actuator Sweep Fix

Patch release **`v2.0.1`** of **MyHOME for Home Assistant** on **[`OWNd 2.0.1`](https://github.com/OpenWebNet-HA/OWNd)** (**Home Assistant 2026.8+** / Python 3.14).

#### ✨ Features

- **Thermoregulation (`WHO = 4`) — Expose `0–10 V` Proportional Actuator Output Level (`Dimension 20` `100..200` → `0..100 %`) ([#949](https://github.com/OpenWebNet-HA/MyHOME/issues/949), [#952](https://github.com/OpenWebNet-HA/MyHOME/pull/952))**: Auto-discovers a per-actuator `%` `SensorEntity` (`MyHOMEActuatorOutputSensor`, `SensorStateClass.MEASUREMENT`) on the zone's Home Assistant device strictly for explicit `Z#N` (`1 <= Z <= 99`, `1 <= N <= 9`) `Dimension 20` proportional codes `100..200` (without requiring bus-wide `generate_events`; no `Z#0` or bare-`Z` level spreading, starts `unknown` after restart until the first bus report rather than restoring stale values, and registers `watch_zone_actuators` when not interface-refused), and exposes `actuator_levels` (`0..100`) on `MyHOMEClimate` (while keeping `actuators` strictly `"on"` / `"off"`) and `output_level` / `actuator_levels` on `MyHOMEThermoSwitch` (all excluded from Home Assistant recorder history via `_unrecorded_attributes` so ramp steps record only on the `sensor`). Thanks to **[@xmavgithub](https://github.com/xmavgithub)** for the live `MyHomeServer1` (`2.87.13`) + `F459` (*HVAC 0-10V FanControl*) + `F430V10` (`0–10 V`) ramp captures!

#### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- **Thermoregulation (`WHO = 4`) — Ignore `WHERE = #0` Actuator Status Answers for Central-Unit Detection, Discovery & Routing ([#944](https://github.com/OpenWebNet-HA/MyHOME/issues/944), [#945](https://github.com/OpenWebNet-HA/MyHOME/pull/945))**: On an `F461` (FW `2.0.11`) plant without a central unit, the all-zone actuator status poll (`*#4*#0*20##`) returned `*#4*#0*20*1##` alongside per-zone actuator frames (`Z#N`), flipping `has_central_unit = True` so discovered standalone zones wrote central-addressed setpoints (`*#4*#Z*#14*TTTT*M##`) that nothing answered and lost off-season modes (`cool` while in heating). `Dimension 20` actuator status frames (both `*#4*...*20*V##` and `#20` write-form echoes) are never treated as central-unit reports on any `#` `WHERE`, `*#4*#0*20*V##` is excluded from climate bus discovery and entity routing across all valve and fan-coil output codes (`0..9`, `14..16`), and central units never queue `*#4*#0*19##` fan-coil side reads. Thanks to **[@lyubomirtraykov](https://github.com/lyubomirtraykov)** for the diagnostic trace report and **[@gdluck](https://github.com/gdluck)** for the fix!

#### ⚙️ CI & Tooling

- **GitHub Actions Pin Updates ([#943](https://github.com/OpenWebNet-HA/MyHOME/pull/943))**: Updated SHA-pinned GitHub Actions across repository workflows (`crowdin/github-action` `v3.6.0`, `actions/setup-python` `v7.1.0`, `docker/login-action` `v4.8.0`, and `actions/upload-artifact` `v7.0.2`).
